mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.person_id) FROM kids_link_own.tb_cm_i_tmpr_person p WHERE 1=1 AND p.inst_task_sn = #{instTaskSn}

SELECT CASE p.gender_concept_id WHEN 8507 THEN 'Male' WHEN 8532 THEN 'Female' ELSE COALESCE(CAST(p.gender_concept_id AS VARCHAR), 'Unknown') END AS "label", COUNT(DISTINCT p.person_id) AS "cnt" FROM kids_link_own.tb_cm_i_tmpr_person p WHERE 1=1 AND p.inst_task_sn = #{instTaskSn} GROUP BY p.gender_concept_id ORDER BY "cnt" DESC

SELECT age_group AS "label", COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) AS "cnt" FROM ( SELECT p.person_id, CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(CURRENT_DATE, bd.birth_dt)) < 10 THEN '0~9세' WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(CURRENT_DATE, bd.birth_dt)) < 20 THEN '10~19세' WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(CURRENT_DATE, bd.birth_dt)) < 30 THEN '20~29세' WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(CURRENT_DATE, bd.birth_dt)) < 40 THEN '30~39세' WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(CURRENT_DATE, bd.birth_dt)) < 50 THEN '40~49세' WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(CURRENT_DATE, bd.birth_dt)) < 60 THEN '50~59세' WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(CURRENT_DATE, bd.birth_dt)) < 70 THEN '60~69세' WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(CURRENT_DATE, bd.birth_dt)) < 80 THEN '70~79세' WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(CURRENT_DATE, bd.birth_dt)) < 90 THEN '80~89세' WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(CURRENT_DATE, bd.birth_dt)) < 100 THEN '90~99세' ELSE '100세 이상' END AS age_group FROM kids_link_own.tb_cm_i_tmpr_person p CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(p.year_of_birth::text,'')), '') IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(COALESCE(p.year_of_birth::text,'')) ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN MAKE_DATE( CAST(TRIM(p.year_of_birth::text) AS INTEGER), COALESCE(CASE WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(p.month_of_birth::text,'')) ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(TRIM(p.month_of_birth::text) AS INTEGER) END, 1), 1 ) ELSE NULL END AS birth_dt ) bd WHERE bd.birth_dt IS NOT NULL AND p.inst_task_sn = #{instTaskSn} ) sub WHERE age_group IS NOT NULL GROUP BY age_group ORDER BY age_group
